identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Human BCMA Targeted T Cells Injection for Subjects With BCMA-positive Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Participants with BCMA-positive relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma can participate if all eligibility criteria are met. Tests required to determine eligibility include disease assessments, a physical exam, Electrocardiograph, CT/MRI/PET, and blood draws. Participants receive chemotherapy prior to the infusion of BCMA CAR+ T cells. After the infusion, participants will be followed for side effects and effect of BCMA CAR+ T cells. Study procedures may be performed while hospitalized.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by NCI-CTCAE 5.0

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Concentration of Anti-BCMA CAR T Cells in blood
Concentration of Anti-BCMA CAR T Cells in bone marrow
Pharmacodynamics (Content of clonal plasma cells in bone marrow)
Negative proportion of minimal residual disease (MRD)
